pages.title: Fewer liquids, further sight
pages.text: Range is decided by how many $(thing)distinct$() liquids are loaded, not by how full the tank is.$(li)$(thing)One$(): 24 down, 18 sideways, 3x3.$(li)$(thing)Two$(): 16 down, 12 sideways, 5x5.$(li)$(thing)Three or more$(): 8 down, 6 sideways, 7x7.

pages.title: The trade
pages.text: A focused detector sees $(thing)deep and narrow$(). A loaded one sees $(thing)wide and shallow$(), and costs more liquid per click because it finds more.$(br2)The tank holds five distinct ores at most. Pouring a bottle in fills whatever space is free and leaves the other charges alone, so a partial pour is allowed and still uses the whole bottle.
